title: Availability status changes immediately when resource becomes available
gherkin:
Feature: Real-time availability update
  Scenario: Resource availability status updates immediately
    Given a resource is currently unavailable
    When the resource becomes available
    Then the availability status should update to available in real-time
    And the update should be reflected within 1 second
rationale: Verifies that the system immediately reflects availability changes without delay, which is core to real-time functionality.
generationSummary: Real-time availability update functionality requires the system to provide immediate updates on resource or service availability status. Test cases cover scenarios for availability status changes, notification delivery, data consistency, and edge cases in real-time update mechanisms.
